headline: Cache trust got real.
summary: Publication is now proven by a clean consumer, two hidden costs left the VM spawn path, and the dashboard gained a web-native agent console. Guest swap also became image-declared.

workstreams.title: Cache and CI trust
workstreams.thesis: A wrong signing key now fails loudly instead of passing a configuration check.
workstreams.now: A non-publisher starts empty, verifies the narinfo signature, resolves the realisation, and reads the published bytes back.

workstreams.title: VM critical path
workstreams.thesis: Two hidden costs left every spawn, and bad golden snapshots are now refused.
workstreams.now: Page runs replace the dense restore index, billing refreshes off-path, and capture requires systemd convergence.

workstreams.title: Agent console
workstreams.thesis: The dashboard stopped treating agents like raw terminal pixels.
workstreams.now: Agent cards show a live transcript and shared compose field; Fleetview PTYs join the same surface.

watchlist.title: Warm-donor-aware placement
watchlist.status: Placement still ignores whether a warm donor is nearby.
watchlist.why: Can avoid the 3.2 s p99 cold materialization path.

watchlist.title: Measure resume → guest-bound
watchlist.status: The final restore latency window still has no owner.

watchlist.title: Browser send semantics
watchlist.status: LF looks delivered while text remains in Claude's input box; switch to CR.

watchlist.title: CI check visibility
watchlist.status: 3,107 check-run publishes failed in seven days.
watchlist.why: The GitHub App still needs checks: write.
